title: 3DS Max
caption: Model, texture, light and render interior and architectural scenes in 3ds Max, then bring them to life with a walkthrough animation.
description: This course takes you from the 3ds Max workspace to finished, rendered scenes. You will model rooms and furniture, work with materials and lighting, and finish with a simple walkthrough animation. It suits architecture, interior design and civil students who want to present their designs as realistic images.

title: Adobe Photoshop
caption: Edit and compose images in Photoshop, from layers and selections to retouching and collages, for clear design presentations.
description: Photoshop is a common tool for finishing images before they are shown to a client. This course covers the workspace, layers, selections, brushes and retouching, and ends with building a collage. It is useful for preparing presentation boards and for polishing renders and photographs.

table_of_contents.title: Painting and retouching
detail: Fill options and the Paint Bucket tool

title: ArcGIS
caption: Learn to build, analyse and share maps with ArcGIS, from GIS fundamentals to spatial analysis.
description: This course introduces geographic information systems and the ArcGIS platform. You will learn how spatial data is structured, how to load and view it, work with coordinate systems and collect data, and carry out basic spatial analysis before publishing your results as maps. It suits civil, planning and environmental students working with location data.

title: AutoCAD for Civil
caption: Draft civil drawings in AutoCAD, from basic 2D tools to plans, elevations and a first look at 3D.
description: You will learn AutoCAD drafting the way civil drawings are produced: precise 2D tools, layers and blocks, dimensions and annotation, and sheets ready to print. Later modules cover templates, external references, plan and elevation drawings, a staircase drawing, and an introduction to 3D modelling and rendering.

table_of_contents.title: Civil drawings
detail: Drawing a plan and front elevation

title: AutoCAD for Land Surveyors
caption: Use AutoCAD, Excel and Google Earth together to draw survey plans, contours and plot layouts.
description: Designed for people who prepare land survey drawings, this course shows how to speed up survey drafting in AutoCAD with LISP routines, automatic dimensions and area calculations. You will import survey points, draw contours, divide irregular plots, and connect the work with Excel and Google Earth. It ends with minor and major project discussions.

table_of_contents.title: Google Earth for surveying
detail: Combining Google Earth with survey data

table_of_contents.title: AutoCAD, Excel and Google Earth together

title: Autodesk Civil 3D
caption: Design surfaces, alignments, profiles and corridors in Civil 3D and calculate quantities for roads and sites.
description: This course follows a typical road and site design workflow in Civil 3D. You will set up a project, import points, build surfaces, lay out alignments and profiles, define assemblies and corridors, take cross sections and calculate earthwork and pavement quantities, then produce reports and a junction design.

title: BIM Modelling (3D BIM)
caption: A full programme from AutoCAD drafting through Revit Architecture, Structure and MEP for building information modelling.
description: This is a long programme that builds a complete BIM skill set. You start with AutoCAD drafting and 3D, then move into Revit: architectural models, structural models with levels, columns, foundations and reinforcement, and MEP systems for electrical, mechanical, plumbing and fire protection. It suits students aiming at BIM and design coordination work.

title: Enscape
caption: Walk through your models in real time and produce images, videos and panoramas with Enscape.
description: Enscape renders directly from your design model, so you can review it as you work. This course covers navigating a model, creating still images, batch renders, videos and panoramas, and adjusting perspective, exposure, backgrounds, fog, clouds and sky, sound and the advanced settings.

title: ETABS
caption: Model multi-storey buildings in ETABS, apply loads, run the analysis and check the results.
description: ETABS is used to analyse and design multi-storey buildings. In this course you set up grids and stories, draw structural, floor and wall objects, define loads and load cases, run the analysis and verify the output, and finish with detailing.

title: Lumion
caption: Turn 3D models into polished visualisations and animations with Lumion.
description: Lumion helps architects present designs as realistic images and films. The course covers setting up a scene and terrain, importing and updating models, materials such as glass, landscaping, lighting and weather, effects, artistic styles, camera animation, and the model library with animated characters and sound.

title: MS Project
caption: Plan and track projects in Microsoft Project with tasks, calendars, resources, costs and baselines.
description: This course teaches how to build a project schedule in Microsoft Project. You will set preferences and calendars, create tasks and a work breakdown structure, read Gantt charts, apply constraints, assign resources and costs, save a baseline, and print and exchange reports.

title: Primavera
caption: Plan and control construction schedules in Primavera P6, from project setup to resource levelling and reports.
description: Primavera P6 is widely used by planning engineers on construction projects. You will learn to set up the enterprise project structure, create projects, activities and relationships, build a work breakdown structure, assign resources and costs, set a baseline, update progress and produce reports.

table_of_contents.title: Introduction and setup
detail: Introduction to Primavera and project management

table_of_contents.title: Creating a project
detail: Activities, start and finish dates and durations

table_of_contents.title: Baseline and execution
detail: Baseline bars on the Gantt chart

title: Revit Architecture
caption: Create building models in Revit Architecture and turn them into documented plans, schedules and sheets.
description: This course teaches building design in Revit Architecture, where plans, sections and schedules all come from one model. You will start a project from templates, model walls, doors, windows, floors, roofs, stairs and openings, add rooms, areas and annotation, then produce views, schedules and sheets. Massing, site design and family creation are covered at the end.

title: Revit MEP
caption: Model ductwork, piping, plumbing, fire protection and electrical systems in Revit MEP.
description: Revit MEP is used to design and coordinate the services of a building. The course introduces BIM and the Revit environment, then covers ductwork and HVAC equipment, piping, plumbing and drainage, sprinklers and fire protection, and lighting, cable trays and electrical equipment, followed by families, annotation, schedules and team collaboration.

title: Revit Structure
caption: Model structural frames, foundations and reinforcement in Revit Structure and document them for construction.
description: This course covers structural modelling in Revit. You will link the architectural model, set up levels, add columns, foundations, retaining walls, beams, braced frames, trusses and slabs, reinforce with rebar, and then detail, schedule and plot the structure.

title: Sketch up
caption: Build 3D models in SketchUp, from furniture to full house interiors, and present them with scenes and walkthroughs.
description: SketchUp is a quick way to model buildings and interiors. The course covers the interface and drawing tools, modelling furniture, tracing a floor plan, building a house interior with moulding, applying materials and photo-matched textures, and presenting the model with annotations, terrain, scenes and walkthroughs.

title: STAAD Pro
caption: Analyse and design RCC and steel structures in STAAD.Pro to Indian standards, including wind, seismic and moving loads.
description: This course covers structural analysis and design in STAAD.Pro. After learning the workspace and how to create geometry, you apply loads and combinations, then design reinforced concrete and steel structures using IS 456 and IS 800, with wind loading to IS 875 and seismic design to IS 1893. It also covers FEM modelling, water tanks, shear walls, moving loads and foundations.

table_of_contents.title: Introduction
detail: Overview of structural analysis and design

table_of_contents.title: Code-based design
detail: Wind load design as per IS 875
Seismic design and analysis as per IS 1893

title: Tekla Structure
caption: Model steel and concrete structures in Tekla Structures and produce drawings, reports and material lists.
description: Tekla Structures is a BIM tool for detailed structural models. You will learn to set up the model geometry, model roofs, foundations, beams and columns, add reinforcement and connections, and generate general arrangement drawings, material takeoffs, reports and plots.

title: Tekla Structure Designer
caption: Analyse and design concrete and steel buildings in Tekla Structural Designer.
description: This course introduces Tekla Structural Designer for analysing and designing buildings. You will set up grids and geometry, define materials, element properties and supports, apply loads, run seismic and dynamic analysis, and design concrete and steel members before preparing reports and drawings.

title: V-Ray
caption: Light, shade and render realistic scenes with V-Ray.
description: V-Ray is a rendering engine used for architectural and product visualisation. This course explains the key concepts behind image quality, lighting tools, global illumination, materials, the physical camera and sun and sky, special effects, and render elements for compositing.

title: Adobe Illustrator
caption: Create logos, illustrations and layouts with Adobe Illustrator's drawing, colour, type and effects tools.
description: This course covers vector drawing in Adobe Illustrator. You will learn the workspace, selections and guides, colour, gradients and layers, the Pen and Pencil tools, brushes and symbols, type, transparency and masks, effects and the Pathfinder, tracing and Live Paint, and finally how to print and export your work.

table_of_contents.title: Drawing
detail: The Pen tools and path editing

title: Adobe Photoshop
caption: Edit photos, build composites and design graphics in Photoshop using layers, masks, brushes and shapes.
description: Photoshop is a widely used tool for editing photographs and building graphics. This course covers the workspace, layers, selecting and transforming, brushes with masks, fills, shape tools and custom shapes, retouching with the Clone Stamp, and creating collages and editing drawings.

table_of_contents.title: Painting and retouching
detail: Fill options and the Paint Bucket tool

title: Diploma in Photography
caption: A diploma covering camera control, lighting, shooting genres and editing in Lightroom and Photoshop.
description: This diploma is for people who love photography and want to build creative and technical skills, whether as a serious hobby or a career. You will learn camera handling and the exposure triangle, composition and lighting, portrait, landscape, fashion and product photography, then edit RAW files in Lightroom and refine images in Photoshop, ending with file management and a portfolio.

table_of_contents.title: Exposure, composition and light
detail: The exposure triangle: aperture, shutter speed and ISO

table_of_contents.title: Editing
detail: RAW image processing in Adobe Lightroom
Advanced photo editing in Adobe Photoshop

title: Graphic Design in CorelDRAW
caption: Design logos, layouts and print artwork with CorelDRAW's vector drawing, colour, text and effects tools.
description: CorelDRAW is a vector drawing application used for graphic design and print work. In this course you will learn the workspace and page setup, drawing, shaping and arranging objects, working with outlines, fills and layers, special effects and text, symbols, bitmaps and tracing, and finally page layout, printing and exporting.

title: Matrix 3D
caption: Design jewellery in MatrixGold, from basic forms and stone settings to engraving, parametric design and presentation.
description: Matrix, now called MatrixGold, is a 3D design program built on the Rhino platform for jewellery design and manufacture. This course covers basic and advanced jewellery modelling, setting gemstones and diamonds, detailing and engraving, parametric design, and preparing presentations and portfolios.

table_of_contents.title: Introduction
detail: Introduction to Matrix for jewellery design

table_of_contents.title: Core techniques
detail: Basic jewellery design techniques in Matrix

title: Product Design and Animation with Blender
caption: Model, texture, animate and render 3D designs and product visuals in Blender.
description: Blender is a free 3D creation suite. In this course you will learn the interface and modelling workflow, edit meshes with extrusion, loop cuts and bevels, use modifiers for non-destructive work, apply materials and textures, animate with keyframes, and render a final project. It suits artists and designers who want to create 3D visuals and simple animations.

table_of_contents.title: Practical modelling
detail: Advanced tools: Boolean operations and the knife tool

title: Rhinoceros
caption: Model curves, surfaces and solids in Rhinoceros for product, jewellery and architectural design.
description: Rhinoceros is a 3D modelling program known for its freeform surface tools. This course introduces the interface, then builds from curves to surfaces and solids, covers transforming and organising objects, and finishes with materials, dimensions and exporting your model.

table_of_contents.title: Transforming and organising
detail: Move, rotate, scale, mirror and arrays

table_of_contents.title: Presentation and output
detail: Exporting for drawings, rendering and 3D printing

title: Adobe Photoshop
caption: Edit and design images for websites and digital media in Photoshop using layers, masks, brushes and shapes.
description: Photoshop is widely used by web developers and designers to prepare images. This course covers the workspace, layers, selecting and transforming, brushes with masks, fills, shape tools and custom shapes, retouching and collaging.

table_of_contents.title: Painting and retouching
detail: Fill options and the Paint Bucket tool

title: Advanced Excel
caption: Work faster and analyse data in Excel with formatting, functions, pivot tables, charts and data tools.
description: This course takes Excel beyond the basics. You will format and clean data, use functions, build pivot tables and charts, import and transform data with Get & Transform, use data tools such as forecasting and outlines, and prepare workbooks for printing and review.

table_of_contents.title: Page setup and views
detail: Scale to fit and page setup
Workbook views, show, zoom and arrange

title: ASP.NET MVC
caption: Build web applications with ASP.NET, from web forms and data access to the MVC pattern and Entity Framework.
description: This course covers web development on Microsoft's .NET platform. You will start with ASP.NET fundamentals such as server controls, state, data access with LINQ, AJAX, security and deployment, then move to the MVC pattern with controllers, views, models and Entity Framework, finishing with a project.

table_of_contents.title: ASP.NET MVC
detail: Introduction to web development with ASP.NET MVC

title: Basics of Python Programming
caption: Learn Python from first principles: data types, functions, object-oriented code, files, databases and basic networking.
description: This course teaches Python programming from the ground up. You will cover syntax, data types, control flow, functions, modules, file handling and object-oriented programming, then exceptions, regular expressions, database access, Tkinter interfaces, threading, CGI and socket programming.

table_of_contents.title: Databases and GUIs
detail: Insert, update, delete and read operations

table_of_contents.title: Threads, web and sockets
detail: Creating a server and a client

title: C Programming
caption: Learn C programming, from variables and control flow to functions, pointers, structures and file handling.
description: C is a structured language used for system software and embedded programming. This course covers program structure and debugging, data types and operators, control flow, input and output, functions, arrays, strings, pointers and structures, and file operations.

table_of_contents.title: File operations
detail: Reading and writing text and binary data
Writing your own file copy function

title: C# Programming
caption: Learn C# and the .NET Framework, from object-oriented basics to threading, delegates and reflection.
description: This course teaches C# programming on the .NET Framework. You will learn the object-oriented approach, value and reference types, constructors, inheritance and polymorphism, file input and output, exception handling, and advanced topics such as multithreading, delegates, events, attributes and reflection.

title: C++ Programming
caption: Learn C++ and object-oriented programming, from classes and constructors to inheritance, overloading and exceptions.
description: C++ extends C with object-oriented features. This course covers the structure of a C++ program, data types, classes and objects, operators and expressions, functions, constructors and destructors, inheritance, operator overloading and exception handling.

table_of_contents.title: Object-oriented thinking
detail: Core ideas of object-oriented programming and why they help
What C++ is and how a program is laid out
Writing the source file, compiling and linking

table_of_contents.title: Variables and data types
detail: Built-in data types and type compatibility
Declaring variables and initialising them at run time

table_of_contents.title: Classes and objects
detail: Declaring a class and defining its member functions
Inline functions defined outside the class
Arrays inside a class and arrays of objects
How memory is allocated for objects

table_of_contents.title: Operators and expressions
detail: Scope resolution and member dereferencing operators
Kinds of expressions and special assignments

table_of_contents.title: Inheritance
detail: Single inheritance and the other inheritance types

table_of_contents.title: Operator overloading
detail: Why and how to overload an operator

title: Core Java
caption: Learn core Java, from syntax and object-oriented programming to threads, file handling, GUIs and JDBC.
description: This course teaches core Java programming. You will learn the language fundamentals and object-oriented concepts, then packages, interfaces, exceptions, threads, file handling and strings, applets, networking with sockets, AWT and Swing interfaces, and database access with JDBC, finishing with a project.

table_of_contents.title: Packages, interfaces and exceptions
detail: Catching and handling exceptions (try, catch, throw)

title: Cyber Security
caption: Learn how systems are attacked and defended, from networking and malware to ethical hacking, CTF challenges and reporting.
description: This course introduces cyber security principles and practice. You will build a virtual lab, learn networking basics, study common attacks and defences, and follow the ethical hacking process from reconnaissance to covering tracks. It ends with two capture-the-flag challenges and writing a vulnerability report. Techniques are taught for defensive and ethical purposes.

title: Data Science with Python
caption: Analyse data with Python using NumPy, SciPy, Pandas and scikit-learn, from exploratory analysis to text processing and big data tools.
description: This course introduces data science with Python. You will learn the analytics process and exploratory analysis, set up Python, compute with NumPy and SciPy, manipulate data with Pandas, process text with scikit-learn, collect data with BeautifulSoup, and see how Python connects with Hadoop and Spark.

table_of_contents.title: Data handling and modelling
detail: Python integration with Hadoop MapReduce and Spark

title: Data Structures & Algorithm
caption: Learn the core data structures and algorithms, with complexity analysis and problem-solving practice.
description: This course covers the building blocks of efficient programs. You will learn complexity analysis, then arrays and linked lists, stacks and queues, trees, hashing, graphs and sorting, and practise problem-solving strategies on algorithm problems.

table_of_contents.title: Algorithms and analysis
detail: Introduction to algorithms and algorithm analysis
Asymptotic notations (Big O, Big Omega, Big Theta)

table_of_contents.title: Linked lists
detail: Singly, doubly and circular linked lists
Variations: skip lists and self-adjusting lists

table_of_contents.title: Trees
detail: Binary trees and binary search trees

table_of_contents.title: Hashing
detail: Load factor, rehashing and performance analysis

table_of_contents.title: Sorting
detail: Divide and conquer sorts (merge sort, quicksort)

title: Digital Marketing
caption: Plan and run digital campaigns across search, display, email, social and mobile, and measure the results.
description: This course covers the main channels of digital marketing: SEO, pay-per-click, display advertising, email, social media and mobile marketing. You will also learn analytics and measurement, and how to plan a strategy with objectives, budgets and KPIs.

table_of_contents.title: Search engine optimisation
detail: How search results are ranked and positioned
Why search position matters and who is involved
Customer insights, keyword research and keyword selection
Content updates, page layout and meta tags
Site maps and SEO webmaster tools

table_of_contents.title: Search engine marketing (PPC)
detail: Conversion tracking and metrics such as CPA and CTR

table_of_contents.title: Digital display advertising
detail: Benefits and challenges of display advertising
Planning a campaign and its steps
Defining the audience, objectives and budget

table_of_contents.title: Email marketing
detail: Capturing data online and face to face

table_of_contents.title: Social media marketing: platforms
detail: Setting social media goals and priorities
Facebook: features, newsfeed, business page and insights
LinkedIn: setup, profile, features and company page

table_of_contents.title: Social media marketing: planning and advertising
detail: Analytics for Facebook, LinkedIn, Twitter (X) and YouTube

table_of_contents.title: Mobile marketing
detail: Mobile advertising goals and ad formats
SMS marketing and its campaign process

table_of_contents.title: Analytics
detail: Account structure, user levels and setup

title: Machine Learning
caption: Learn core machine learning methods, from regression and clustering to neural networks and model selection.
description: This course introduces machine learning. After setting up your environment you will study regression, classification, clustering, association rules and reinforcement learning, build neural networks including convolutional networks, reduce dimensions with PCA, LDA and Kernel PCA, and improve results with model selection and boosting.

table_of_contents.title: Getting started
detail: Introduction to machine learning and set-up

title: Microsoft SQL Server
caption: Learn to query, build and tune relational databases in Microsoft SQL Server.
description: This course teaches working with databases in Microsoft SQL Server. You will learn relational database concepts, write queries with joins and subqueries, create and manage databases and tables, and implement indexes, views, stored procedures, functions, triggers and transactions, finishing with monitoring and performance tuning.

title: PHP
caption: Build dynamic websites with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap and PHP with MySQL.
description: This course takes you from front-end basics to server-side development. You will learn HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery and Bootstrap, then PHP: forms, control flow, functions, strings, arrays, files, sessions and cookies, MySQL database access, authentication and object-oriented programming, finishing with a project.

table_of_contents.title: JavaScript and jQuery
detail: jQuery hide, show and toggle effects

table_of_contents.title: Bootstrap
detail: Designing web pages with Bootstrap classes

table_of_contents.title: Functions, strings and arrays
detail: Call by value and call by reference

title: Power BI
caption: Turn data from many sources into interactive dashboards with Power BI, Power Query, DAX and visualisations.
description: This course teaches business intelligence with Power BI. You will connect and clean data with Power Query and the M language, model relationships, write DAX measures and calculated columns with date, text and logical functions, and design interactive reports using a range of chart types.

table_of_contents.title: Introduction to business intelligence
detail: Power BI Desktop (Power Query, Power Pivot, Power View)

table_of_contents.title: Power Query
detail: Overview of Power Query and the Query Editor

The data view and results pane
Data types and changing column types
Using the first row as headers

detail: DAX table and column name syntax

table_of_contents.title: DAX functions
detail: Date functions: YEAR, MONTH, DAY, WEEKDAY, WEEKNUM, FORMAT, DATE, TODAY, NOW, HOUR, MINUTE, SECOND, TIME, DATEDIFF, CALENDAR
Text functions: LEN, CONCATENATE, LEFT, RIGHT, MID, UPPER, LOWER, TRIM, SUBSTITUTE, BLANK
Logical functions: IF, TRUE, FALSE, NOT, OR, IN, AND, IFERROR, SWITCH

table_of_contents.title: Visualisations
detail: Stacked bar and stacked column charts

title: Tally ERP
caption: Keep business accounts in Tally, from vouchers and inventory to banking, TDS, TCS and GST.
description: This course teaches accounting with Tally. You will create companies, ledgers and vouchers, handle purchases, sales and discounts, manage budgets and banking, maintain inventory with godowns, batches and bills of material, secure and back up your data, and work with TDS, TCS and GST.

table_of_contents.title: Purchases and sales
detail: Orders, notes and rejections in and out

title: Web Design
caption: Design and build responsive websites with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery and Bootstrap.
description: This course covers front-end web design. You will build pages with HTML, style them with CSS, add behaviour with JavaScript and jQuery, and make them responsive with Bootstrap's grid, components and helper classes.

title: AutoCAD Electrical
caption: Draw electrical control schematics, panel layouts and reports in AutoCAD Electrical.
description: This course teaches electrical drawing with AutoCAD Electrical. After the drafting basics, you will manage projects, build schematics with wires, terminals, ladders, PLC and connector symbols, lay out control panels, and generate component reports and audits.

table_of_contents.title: Project tab
detail: Creating a new drawing in a project

title: CATIA Electrical
caption: Define electrical components, route wires and flatten harnesses in CATIA, then produce manufacturing drawings.
description: CATIA Electrical covers electrical design inside the CATIA environment. You will review sketching, part design and assembly, then define electrical components, route wires, flatten harnesses for manufacture, create 2D manufacturing drawings and look at reverse engineering.

title: EPLAN Electric
caption: Plan, document and manage electrical projects in EPLAN Electric P8 to IEC standards.
description: EPLAN Electric P8 is used to design and document electrical systems. This course covers creating projects and pages, drawing schematics with cross-references and parts, using macros, searching and replacing identifiers, accessing master data, generating reports and exporting or printing the finished project, with designs following IEC 81346 and IEC 61355.

table_of_contents.title: Schematics
detail: Selecting parts and creating external parts

title: ETAP
caption: Model power systems in ETAP and run load flow, short circuit, protection and arc flash studies.
description: ETAP is used to simulate and study electrical power systems. This course starts with power system fundamentals and a single line diagram, then covers load flow, cable and transformer sizing, generator load sharing, short circuit analysis, protection coordination, arc flash, motor starting and harmonic analysis.

table_of_contents.title: Foundations
detail: Designing and simulating an electrical power system

title: PLC
caption: Learn PLC hardware and ladder programming, from basic instructions to timers, counters and SCADA communication.
description: This course introduces industrial automation and programmable logic controllers. You will learn PLC architecture and wiring, write ladder programs using contacts, coils, timers, counters, comparison, maths and advanced instructions, and connect a PLC to SCADA software. Hands-on exercises use real-time applications.

table_of_contents.title: PLC fundamentals
detail: Introduction to the programmable logic controller (PLC)
Wiring field devices to a PLC

table_of_contents.title: Programming basics
detail: Sequential input and output instructions (NO, NC, coil, latch, unlatch, OSR)
Ladder programming with logic gates and interlocking

title: Revit MEP
caption: Model ductwork, piping, plumbing, fire protection and electrical systems in Revit MEP.
description: Revit MEP is used to design and coordinate building services. This course covers BIM basics, HVAC, piping, plumbing and fire protection, and in particular electrical systems: light fixtures, devices, cable trays, cables and equipment. It also covers families, annotations, schedules and collaboration.

title: ANSYS WB
caption: Set up and run finite element analyses in ANSYS Workbench, from geometry and meshing to structural and thermal studies.
description: This course introduces finite element analysis and the ANSYS Workbench environment. You will prepare geometry, assign materials, build a mesh with contacts and joints, and run structural, modal, thermal, buckling and dynamic studies before reviewing the results and producing a report. It is suitable for beginners in simulation.

detail: General procedure for an FEA study

table_of_contents.title: Engineering data

table_of_contents.title: DesignModeler

title: ArtCAM
caption: Design vectors, bitmaps and 3D reliefs in ArtCAM and generate toolpaths for engraving and carving machines.
description: ArtCAM is used to design artistic and relief work and prepare it for CNC machining. This course covers vector drawing and editing, layers, bitmaps, 3D relief modelling, and both 2D and 3D toolpaths such as profiling, V-bit carving, engraving, relief machining and Z-level roughing. It suits wood, signage and craft production.

Pasting a relief along a curve

title: AutoCAD for Mechanical
caption: Produce accurate mechanical drawings in AutoCAD, from technical-drawing basics to isometric views and 3D solids.
description: This course is for mechanical students and technicians who need to draw to engineering standards. It starts with technical drawing fundamentals and projection, then covers drawing, dimensioning and annotation tools, layers and blocks, layouts and printing, isometric and orthographic views, and an introduction to 3D solid modelling and rendering.

title: Autodesk Inventor
caption: Design parts, assemblies, sheet metal and drawings in Autodesk Inventor using parametric 3D modelling.
description: This course covers mechanical design in Inventor from sketch to documentation. You will build parametric parts, work with surfaces and sheet metal, assemble components with constraints and joints, and produce drawings with views, parts lists and balloons.

title: CATIA
caption: Design parts, surfaces, sheet metal and assemblies in CATIA V5 and document them with drawings.
description: CATIA V5 is used for mechanical, automotive and aerospace design. In this course you will learn sketching, part design, wireframe and surface modelling, sheet metal design, assemblies with constraints and interference checks, and drawings with annotations, GD&T symbols, balloons and a bill of material.

table_of_contents.title: Introduction
detail: Introduction to product design and CAD/CAM/CAE

title: CNC Programming
caption: Write CNC part programs for lathe and milling operations and prove them on a simulator.
description: This course teaches the basics of CNC programming with a machine simulator. You will learn G-codes and M-codes, workpiece and tool offset settings, and part programming for turning and milling, then import and export programs, record simulations and measure the finished workpiece.

title: Creo
caption: Model parts, surfaces, sheet metal and assemblies in Creo Parametric and prepare detailed drawings.
description: Creo Parametric is a 3D CAD tool for product design. This course takes you through sketching, solid and surface part modelling, sheet metal design, assembly with constraints and connections, and finally drawings with projection and section views, annotations and a bill of materials.

table_of_contents.title: Introduction
detail: The Creo interface and view toolbar

title: Fusion 360
caption: Design, render, animate and document products in Fusion 360, from sketches to free-form shapes and assemblies.
description: Fusion 360 brings sketching, solid and surface modelling, sculpting, assemblies, rendering, animation and drawings into one program. This course covers each workspace in turn, so you can take a product from first sketch to a documented, presentation-ready design.

table_of_contents.title: Introduction
detail: Introduction to product design and CAD/CAM/CAE

detail: T-spline box, cylinder, sphere and more
Face, extrude, revolve, sweep and loft
Inserting edges and points, and subdividing
Merging edges, bridging, filling holes, erasing and filling

title: GD&T
caption: Read and apply geometric dimensioning and tolerancing, from fits and limits to datums, position and run-out controls.
description: GD&T is the symbol language used on engineering drawings to control how much a feature may vary in size, shape, orientation and position. This course explains tolerance basics, the GD&T rules and symbols, form, orientation, profile and position controls, datums and modifiers, and run-out, so you can read and write drawings with confidence.

table_of_contents.title: Datums, modifiers and virtual condition
detail: What datums are and how to apply them to parts

table_of_contents.title: Orientation and profile tolerances

title: NX CAD
caption: Design parts and assemblies in Siemens NX with sketching, surfacing, drafting and analysis.
description: This course covers 3D design in Siemens NX. You will learn the interface and sketch tools, modify and measure geometry, build surface models, assemble parts, dimension and annotate, create drawings, and analyse products and assemblies.

title: NX CAM
caption: Generate machining programs in Siemens NX for milling, turning, boring and drilling.
description: This course introduces computer-aided manufacturing in Siemens NX. You will learn about milling machines, cutters and cutter materials, then create multi-axis milling, turning, boring and drilling operations, including mixed drilling and turning.

title: Primavera
caption: Plan, schedule and monitor projects in Primavera P6, from enterprise structure to resource levelling and reports.
description: Primavera P6 is a project planning tool used for projects of all sizes. You will learn to set up the enterprise project structure, create projects, activities and relationships, build a work breakdown structure, assign resources and costs, set a baseline, update progress and produce reports.

title: Product Design and Animation with Blender
caption: Model, texture, animate and render product designs in Blender.
description: Blender is a free 3D creation suite. In this course you will learn the interface and modelling workflow, edit meshes with extrusion, loop cuts and bevels, use modifiers for non-destructive work, apply materials and textures, animate with keyframes, and render a final project. It suits product and mechanical design students who want to visualise and present their designs.

title: Revit MEP
caption: Model ductwork, piping, plumbing, fire protection and electrical systems in Revit MEP.
description: Revit MEP is used to design and coordinate the mechanical, electrical and plumbing services of a building. This course covers HVAC and ductwork, piping and plumbing with sloped drainage, fire protection and sprinklers, and electrical fixtures, devices and cable trays, followed by families, annotations, schedules and team collaboration.

title: Solidworks
caption: Design parts, sheet metal, surfaces, weldments and assemblies in SolidWorks and turn them into engineering drawings.
description: SolidWorks is widely used for product and machine design. This course covers sketching and part design, sheet metal, surfacing, weldments, assemblies with mates and motion studies, and engineering drawings with views, annotations and bills of materials.
